text.text:
You mean that Alter Ego did not choose to ban servers with high pings during servers ban&pick, and then relied on the opponent's pity to let them choose servers with pings advantages over AE? 

Then the opponent chose servers that were advantageous to them according to the RULEs. And AE lost the game 6-26 (especially Nuke 1-13) entirely due to pings' problem, not because of their gaming skills. All of this was because the opponent lacked sportsmanship and did not choose to show mercy to AE, which are unable to allow members to play in one area, at the same time with a player in the team who has racial discrimination against China.

Let me tell u sth :
-hltv.org/matches/2385764/semperfi-vs-alter-ego-cs-asia-championships-2025-asia-closed-qualifier
According to the manager of Semperfi, in this match, AE played in 30 pings while Semperfi all played in 120 pings. And Semperfi lost not saying anything at that time. Who is the one lack of  sportsmanship here?
-hltv.org/matches/2391673/lynn-vision-vs-alter-ego-cs-asia-championships-2026-asia-closed-qualifier
Here LVG all played in 70+ pings while AE played in 7 pings. AE lost with 1-2. Again, who is the one lack of  sportsmanship here?

Above all, servers ban&pick is not only done once. If there is still a high delay among AE, they can apply to the referee for another server ban&pick. Polbandana, who thought AE could be more powerful than TYLOO, only accused TYLOO of "pingspoofing to gain advantages". Obviously, the AE team itself does not have the conditions to be called a professional team. They want to play Begging Strike instead of Counter Strike. 

When they have the advantage of pings, they do not choose to "pity" their opponents, and when they do not have that, they instead demand mercy from their opponents. Is this what you think of as a professional competition? Or you believe that TYLOO is weaker than AE?TYLOO should forfeit the match  just because the opponent cant find a room to allow all members to play offline ?
